messages:
Maria Gomez: @channel quick sync — we need to coordinate a breaking change for the partner API: removing legacy "envelope" wrapper in generation responses. Target rollout in ~6 weeks, proposed 4-week deprecation window. Marketplace asks for 8 weeks public notice. Thoughts?

Josh Lee: Do we have a list of partner integrations that will break? pinging Alicia for marketplace impact.

Alicia - Marketplace PM: We have ~12 vendors still on the old envelope shape; marketplace listings and example code need updates. We need ~2 weeks to update the marketplace UI messaging and docs. I'll prioritize the top 5 vendors.

Emily Chen: For SDKs: we can add a compatibility shim in v3.2 that auto-detects the legacy envelope and normalizes the payload. Also add a feature flag so customers can opt into strict mode. Proposed deprecation header: `X-Redwood-SDK-Legacy: deprecated`.

Raj Patel: For SIs, recommend a concierge migration offer (2 sessions each) and a 3-partner canary cohort so we can monitor regressions. Need rollback playbook if any canary spikes error rates.

Maria Gomez: Good. Proposal: announce publicly, then 4 weeks of docs + SDK shims + partner outreach, then 4 weeks partner migration window, then sunset. Marketplace still requests an 8-week public notice — can we fold that into the timeline?

Josh Lee: From eng side, checklist: enumerate affected endpoints, field-level diffs, automated unit/integration tests, e2e runs on Dedicated, and a canary gating job. I'll start an impact matrix in the repo (link incoming).

Emily Chen: Quick shim prototype (for SDK teams):
```
// shim: normalize legacy envelope
if (resp && resp.envelope) {
  const payload = resp.envelope.payload || resp.envelope;
  resp = payload;
}
```
I'll open the PR against sdk-main and include migration notes. Can ship the patch in ~3 business days.

Partner Ops Bot: Reminder: create partner comms thread in #partner-comms and set vendor town hall invite after partner list is locked.

Alicia - Marketplace PM: Confirming town hall slot: Thu 10am PT works for marketplace vendors. I'll send calendar invites once we lock the partner list.

Maria Gomez: Action items recap: Josh -> technical impact matrix by EOD tomorrow; Emily -> SDK shim PR + release notes; Alicia -> draft marketplace comms + town hall invites; Raj -> pick 3 SI canaries and prepare concierge plan. I'll consolidate partner announcement plan and publish to #partner-announce. :white_check_mark: 

Josh Lee: on it.

Emily Chen: will have PR ready, including tests. :rocket:

Raj Patel: picking canaries, will DM Maria the names.

Alicia - Marketplace PM: thanks everyone — I'll coordinate vendor invites and patch marketplace docs once PRs land.

Maria Gomez: Quick sync today at 3pm PT to finalize cadence — invite sent. :calendar:
